title: Approve development plan and gates
decision: Build in the order M1 to M6 with an estimate of 18 to 31 focused days and no calendar commitment; interviews and a hands-on pDaftar test must finish before M3; legal review must finish before any real customer data is processed
context: Two validation checks were deferred at earlier stages by founder decision; the plan places them as hard gates where a stop decision is cheapest
chosen_option: Six milestones with two hard gates
rationale: Builds the cheap one-sided ledger first, tests the unproven differentiation before investing in it (EVID-019, EVID-020), and keeps real personal data out until compliance is reviewed (EVID-027)
